contract: D-MASH local Node owner API v4

rootSessionToken.representation: opaque object reference registered by coordinator
rootSessionToken.comparison: strict object identity, never caller string/boolean
rootSessionToken.authority: root session identification only; not Account/route ownership

ownerCapability.representation: separate opaque object reference registered by local owner authority
ownerCapability.accountMutationGuard: independent Account generation; invalidated by logout/switch

bootstrap.purpose: exchange authenticated binding receipts before active Account route mapping

reservedLocalAPIs: prepareLocalBinding(ownerCapability, migrationId, bindingDigest, expectedGeneration, certificate, privateMaterial)
invariants: migration IDs and digests alone confer no authority
matching immutable tuple is required for idempotent retry
private arrays consumed and zeroed on all terminal outcomes
pending final binding is not advertised or Account-dispatchable
separate bounded bootstrap handler never delivers user payload
cross-database commit is journaled and resumable, not globally atomic
